outcome: Model-visible async operation progress and final results are delivered without unnecessary prompt-prefix rewrites or cache invalidation.
currentProblem: Async operations only save model cost if their state can be surfaced without repeatedly rebuilding or mutating old prompt history. ExHarness has bounded context rendering but no committed-prefix/staged-suffix contract for RUNNING-to-terminal tool results.
constraints: Canonical operation/effect state must not be inferred from prompt text.
Earlier committed prompt content must not be rewritten solely to update a running operation.
Provider-specific multiple-result behavior must be capability-checked; unsupported semantics require an explicit compatible encoding or synchronous fallback.
Cache metrics are observational optimization evidence, never correctness authority.
successCriteria: A RUNNING operation can be surfaced once and its later terminal result appended/advanced without rewriting unrelated committed history.
Repeated equivalent turns preserve a stable prefix/cache key where the provider supports caching, with cache-hit/input-token evidence captured when available.
Providers that reject progressive tool-result semantics follow an explicit tested fallback without corrupting tool-call/result pairing.
